claim_boundary: Read-only structural analysis. Exact UTF-8 source prefixes and source-position sensitivity are not Lean-native executable prefix matches, verifier-cost fractions, measured speedups, or benchmark results. No Lean process was run.

corpus.name: Goedel-LM Lean Workbook proofs
corpus.version: HF dataset Goedel-LM/Lean-workbook-proofs (29,750 upstream proofs ingested; 29,985 optimizer attempts after pool expansion, of which 29,676 verified and 11,367 accepted -- see analysis/corpus_stats_v2.json)

gate.reason: Source structure may justify a later feasibility design, but neither corpus currently supplies a conservative lower bound on reusable verifier CPU.

grouping.APRIL: src_hash; one unique correct proof plus unique incorrect proofs

method.nontrivia_lexer: descriptive nested-comment/string-aware byte counter; not Lean-native syntax
method.prefix: exact common UTF-8 bytes from complete-source root
method.proof_marker: descriptive regex :=\s*by; not a Lean parser boundary
method.sensitivity_formula: n / (p + n*(1-p) + 0.02*n), with source-position fraction p counterfactually substituted for verifier-cost fraction
